segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct SimplePresentation: SpatialTemplate { enum Role: String, SpatialTemplateRole { case presenter } let configuration = SpatialTemplateConfiguration(defaultInitiatorRole: Role.presenter) var elements: [any SpatialTemplateElement] { let audienceCenterPoint = SpatialTemplateElementPosition.app.offsetBy(x: 0, z: 4) let presenter = SpatialTemplateSeatElement( position: .app.offsetBy(x: -3, z: 1), direction: .lookingAt(audienceCenterPoint), role: Role.presenter ) let audience: [any SpatialTemplateElement] = [ .seat(position: audienceCenterPoint.offsetBy(x: -0.5, z: 0), direction: .lookingAt(presenter)), .seat(position: audienceCenterPoint.offsetBy(x: 0.5, z: 0), direction: .lookingAt(presenter)), .seat(position: audienceCenterPoint.offsetBy(x: -1.0, z: 0), direction: .lookingAt(presenter)), .seat(position: audienceCenterPoint.offsetBy(x: 1.0, z: 0), direction: .lookingAt(presenter)), ] return [presenter] + audience } } ```
segments.contextBefore: The inclusion of direction parameters causes the presenter to look at the audience and the audience to look at the presenter by default.
